propositions.text: That star is shining at its highest level (exalted)
propositions.evidence: The derivation gives dignity 'exalted' for Venus, and the glossary defines 'exalted' as 'Placed in its exaltation sign, the sign where the texts hold a planet at its strongest', which matches the sentence's phrasing

propositions.text: The divisional chart places Saturn in Capricorn
propositions.evidence: The varga finding's derivation gives planet Saturn, varga D9, varga_sign 'Capricorn'; the glossary defines a varga as 'A divisional chart'

propositions.text: Saturn is in its own sign in that divisional chart

propositions.text: In the reading's view, the rest of the chart leans favourably (on the matter of marriage).
propositions.evidence: Both cited findings carry direction "for" (vote:marriage.house and vote:marriage.lord, each 6 for vs 1 against).

propositions.text: There are houses that govern the client's union (marriage houses), and the sentence is referring to them as "the rooms that govern your union".
propositions.evidence: area_houses in both findings list these houses in exactly those words: "the 7th, a marriage house", "the 2nd, a marriage house", "the 11th, a marriage house", "the 8th, a marriage house" (plus the Moon- and Sun-based and Bhavat Bhavam variants).

propositions.text: Those marriage houses are backed by their rulers (their lords stand behind/support them).
propositions.evidence: Generic framing of the cited lord vote: vote:marriage.lord has direction "for" (verdict lord: for). Caveat: if read positionally — each lord sitting in its own house — that is only true of the 7th (Mars in the 7th); the 2nd's lord is in the 10th and the 11th/8th lords are in the 1st, so that stronger reading would not be stated for all the houses.

propositions.text: The 7th house has a ruling star (planet).
propositions.evidence: vote:marriage.lord derivation, basis lagna, house 7: sign Scorpio, lord Mars.

propositions.text: The star that rules the 7th house rests in Scorpio.
That ruler sits inside the 7th house itself ("that very room").
The ruler is completely at home there, i.e. in its own sign (Scorpio) in the 7th.
propositions.evidence: vote:marriage.lord derivation, basis lagna, house 7: "dignity": "own" (and the same for the Moon-basis 7th and 2nd). Note: the glossaries contain an entry for "exalted" but none for "own"; I read "feels completely at home" not as a definition beside a named term but as the sentence's own paraphrase of the own-sign dignity, which the cited finding states. If read as a gloss of the term "own", it would be unsupported, since that term has no glossary entry.
